strings.name: Lee Hae-jin
strings.summary: Lee Hae-jin is a South Korean internet entrepreneur who worked at Samsung SDS before helping found NAVER and develop search and international platform businesses. His career spans NHN, LINE expansion and global investment. He returned as NAVER board chairman in 2025 and participates in AI infrastructure partnerships.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Board chair and CEO, incorporation and earlier projects, agreements, investment closing and infrastructure operation are distinct. Team products are not individual inventions.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founded Naver, advancing search, digital content and communications platforms, with influence on Korean and international internet services.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Computer engineering bachelor’s from Seoul National University in 1990 and computing master’s from KAIST in 1992. KAIST’s laboratory alumni list also records him among the 1992 master’s graduates.
strings.facts.f2.label: Board chair and management
strings.facts.f2.value: Shareholders elected him an inside director in March 2025; the subsequent board meeting elected him chairman. Choi Soo-yeon remained CEO.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Search and international communications
strings.highlights.h1.text: Expanded from Korean search into overseas services including LINE. Strategy, engineering and operations involve teams and partners across locations.
strings.highlights.h2.title: AI computing partnerships
strings.highlights.h2.text: Participates in NAVER’s cooperation with NVIDIA and Brookfield. The infrastructure agreement was signed in October 2026; subsequent equity transactions and phased construction were not thereby all completed.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Company signs Brookfield infrastructure agreement
strings.timeline.t1.text: Announcement says a precondition for NVIDIA’s strategic equity investment is met, with capital-increase procedures still to complete. Phased operation targets for 2027–2028 remain plans.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Returns as NAVER board chairman
strings.timeline.t2.text: Appointed by the board after the shareholders’ meeting to guide longer-term direction; the chair role does not replace Choi Soo-yeon as CEO.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Receives Seoul National University alumni honor
strings.timeline.t3.text: Named a Proud SNU alumnus; an alumni honor, not a new degree or a company award.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Moves into global investment
strings.timeline.t4.text: Ends his previous NAVER chairmanship and becomes global investment officer. This historical role does not supersede his return as chairman in 2025.
strings.timeline.t5.title: NAVER and gaming business complete split
strings.timeline.t5.text: Official history records the separation of NAVER and NHN Entertainment. Restructuring is not the first founding of NAVER search.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Japan team launches LINE
strings.timeline.t6.text: NHN Japan launches the communications app, initially focused on text messages. A team and company milestone, not an individual invention.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Company renamed NHN
strings.timeline.t7.text: Renamed after combining with Hangame and other businesses in 2000. Business combination and name change occurred in different years.
strings.timeline.t8.title: NAVER.com incorporated and search portal launched
strings.timeline.t8.text: Official corporate history dates incorporation and portal launch here, separately from earlier internal search development at Samsung SDS.
